description: EXPERIMENTAL. Needs iPhone Mirroring and a python3 with pyobjc. Type text via the clipboard (IME-safe; never echoes the typed text). Refused with mirror_not_live or mirror_state_unknown when the mirror is not live or its state cannot be confirmed. Saves every clipboard item and type, clearing concealed or transient items instead of copying, and restores only after OCR sees the text appear within its 2.5 s check (Universal Clipboard or >64 MB items are not copied and leave the typed text on the clipboard; a paste confirmed late or type_not_confirmed also leaves the typed text on the clipboard). replace=true selects all and overwrites the field. Optional expect: on-screen text (OCR), else nothing is sent. Reports delivery and retry.
name: phone_type
